[SWS_CM_80505] Data accumulation for
UDP
data transmission (
Signal-Based
Static
network binding)
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
To allow for the transmission of multiple messages (signal-based events and signal-
based field notifiers) within a single
UDP
datagram, data accumulation for
UDP
data
transmission shall be supported.
⌋
